_doc: Bystander reactions + memory lines (NPCVoice). Kinds/stances: data/reactions.json. {target} = who/what it was done to.

now_charity: Somebody just helped somebody. Call Lumen.
Was that charity? Is that still legal?
Credits for nothing? Who ARE you?
Look at that. Kindness. In public.
now_threat: That's no way to talk to {target}.
now_fight: Oh, they're really going at it.
And there goes the insurance premium.
now_murder: Somebody call - no. Nobody call. Run.
I didn't see anything! I didn't see anything!
now_mercy: You could have finished it. You didn't.
now_kill_cop: Paragon's going to burn the block for this.
Did you just... in front of everyone?
now_kill_repo: Halcyon's gonna bill somebody for that.
now_skill: Slow-motion! I swear it went slow-motion!
now_show: Is that legal? It looks fun.
now_beg: Spare change for the drifter, anyone?
now_deal: I didn't see that. Unless I get a cut.
now_weird: I'm going to pretend that was normal.
now_vice: Leave some for the rest of us!
now_shady: Nobody comes out of there richer.
now_dance: Is that the jingle? Are you dancing to the JINGLE?
judge_approve: The Sprawl needs more of that.
judge_disapprove: That's not how we do things here.
And people wonder why the air's so bad.
#faction# would be proud. That's not a compliment.
judge_fear: I'm just going to... back away.
judge_amused: Best thing I've seen all week.
I'd pay to see that again.
judge_hurt_approve: Sit down before you fall down.
Want me to call someone? Anyone?
judge_hurt_amused: That's going to bruise in interesting colours.
judge_charity_disapprove: That's not how the economy works.
judge_threat_approve: That's how you close a negotiation.
judge_dance_disapprove: Dancing is billed by the minute, you know.
act_charity: helped {target} out when nobody else would
act_threat: made {target} an offer with teeth in it
act_theft: helped yourself to the stuff of {target}
act_fight: turned the street into a boxing ring
act_murder: left {target} on the pavement for good
act_kill_cop: took down a cop in the street
put {target} down. A cop. In the street
act_kill_repo: turned a repo drone into spare parts
put a debt collector out of business
act_skill: dodged {target} like it owed you money
moved like a hologram on fast-forward
pulled a move I've only seen on #media_product#
danced around {target} like it was nothing
act_show: gave {target} a speech and a half
act_weird: said things to {target} that nobody understood
act_dance: danced like nobody was billing you
act_hurt: came out of a fight bleeding
recall_open: Don't think I didn't see. You
I was right there when you
gossip_open: Lumen didn't air it, but everyone knows you
They're saying in the queue that you
rep_open: The street's favourite story is how you
If you ask the queue at the noodle stall: you
Lumen hasn't caught on, but the street knows you
rep_count: There are {stories} versions going round. They get bigger every time.
rep_nothing: People? About you? Nothing. You're nobody yet. Enjoy it.
Never heard of you. That's a compliment on {planet}.
Nobody's said a word. Either you're careful or you're boring.
after_charity_ok: I'm going to tell everyone about you.
Nobody's done that for me in years.
I'll pay it forward. Probably. Eventually.
You're not like the others on {planet}.
after_charity_fail: Keep it. I don't take charity.
after_threat_ok: I'm going to remember your face. From very far away.
after_threat_fail: I've been threatened by #faction#. You're nothing.
Is that supposed to be scary?
after_theft_fail: Try that again and lose the hand.
after_fight_ok: That's going on your record. Somewhere.
after_show_ok: Do it again! Do it again!
You should have a show on Lumen.
Best thing I've seen on {planet} all week.
after_beg_ok: Here. Don't tell anyone I'm soft.
Times are hard. I get it.
after_beg_fail: I'm two payments from begging myself.
after_weird_ok: That was the strangest thing that's happened to me today. And I live here.
I'm going to need a minute.
after_weird_fail: I'm going to walk away now.
merchant_ask: Buying, selling, or wasting my billable time?
Take a look. Touching is extra.
Today only: prices. Tomorrow: higher prices.
Got something to sell? I've got something to sell you back.
grudge_call: Paragon? Yes. I'd like to report a person.
Hello, complaints? You're going to love this one.
I'm calling it in. Don't try to stop me.
Paragon? I have a name and a face for you.
furious_bark: You've got some nerve showing your face.
I hope your air runs out, {name}.
Everyone - that's the one I told you about!
I'm still not over what you did.
Paragon has your description, you know.
devoted_bark: If anyone gives you trouble, they answer to me.
I told the whole block about you.
favour_line: Hey - {name}! I owe you. Take this.
I said I'd pay you back. I'm a person of my word. Mostly.
For what you did before. Don't argue.
Here. It's not much, but it's yours.
You helped me. Now I help you. That's how it should work.
robbed_notice: Someone took my credits! SOMEONE TOOK MY CREDITS!
No no no - my ration card! Gone!
I've been robbed! On #day#! Who robs on #day#?
My pocket's lighter. Why is my pocket lighter?
robbed_accuse: YOU! You were standing right next to me!
I knew you were too friendly.
fan_bark: That's {name}! I know them! Sort of!
Can't wait to see what you do next!
heckle_bark: Oh look, it's the one who flopped earlier!
Hey! Do the thing again! The bad thing!
I've seen better from a vending machine.
heckle_laugh: Stop, I can't breathe. And breathing's expensive.
spooked_bark: I'm not looking at you. I'm NOT looking.
Keep that energy away from me!
intrigued_bark: So where are you from? Really from?
Is it true what they say about you?
Do you have a ship? You have a ship, don't you?
What's it like out there? Off-world?
smitten_bark: I'm not following you. We're just going the same way.
Do you like noodles? I like noodles.
intrigued_bye: Okay, I've got to go. But listen - one thing.
Thanks for not being boring. Here's something for you.
You're the most interesting thing on {planet}. Take this tip.
keeper_greet_warm: Look who's back! Best customer on {planet}.
Come in, come in! Mind the puddle.
keeper_greet_neutral: Welcome to {sign}. Don't touch anything you can't afford.
Welcome. Everything's for sale except me. Make me an offer.
keeper_greet_afraid: Anything you want. On the house. Please don't...
I'll give you the good price. The very good price.
keeper_regular: My regular! Your seat's still warm.
Regulars get the good stuff. You're a regular.
I saved you the corner spot.
keeper_fan: {name}! In MY shop! Can I put your picture on the wall?
My favourite customer AND my favourite celebrity!
keeper_partner: Partner. Back room's open, if you know what I mean.
Ah, my business associate. Discreetly, please.
Got something new under the counter. For you.
